title: Mission to Mars
summary: Plan a rover mission with NASA footage.

nodes.text: Mission control! A rover is ready for Mars. What is the first step?
nodes.video: nasa:JPL-20200518-M2020f-0001-Shake Rattle and Roll Testing NASAs Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover

nodes.text: Engineers shake the rover to make sure it survives the launch.
Landing on Mars takes about seven minutes of careful steps.
nodes.video: nasa:JPL-20210222-M2020f-0001-Perseverance Rover’s Descent and Touchdown on Mars

nodes.text: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun. Jupiter is the biggest.
Skipping tests is risky. Good engineers always test first, so the team tests anyway.
Touchdown! The rover explores an ancient river on Mars.
nodes.video: nasa:JPL-20231227-M2020f-0001-Perseverance Rover Zooms in on Ancient Mars River

nodes.text: Mission complete. Welcome to the space team!
